claim.claim-text: 1. A method of preparing a medical isotope, the method comprising:
2. The method claim 1, wherein the dissolved metallic precursor comprises UO<2>2+

, Ac<3+>, Pu<4+>, and Np<4+>, wherein the first mixture has an acidic pH of 1 or lower, wherein separating the medical isotope from one or more metal ions in the dissolved metallic precursor comprises separating UO<2>2+
and Ac<3+> from Pu<4+> and Np<4+> in the mixture based on an interaction or lack of interaction between the octadentate ligand and each of UO<2>2+

, Ac<3+>, Pu<4+>, and Np<4+>, the method further comprising generating a second mixture comprising the Pu<4+> and Np<4+>, and further separating each metal within both mixtures by classical techniques.
3. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein acidic condition denotes a pH of between about 1 to about 0.
4. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the octadentate ligand is a hydroxypyridonate ligand.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the octadentate ligand is built on a spermine scaffold.
6. The method of claim 4, wherein the octadentate ligand is 3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO).
7. The method of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising lowering a pH beneath 0 to separate tetravalent ions.
8. The method of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising an extractant.

9. The method of claim 8, wherein the extractant is selected from the group consisting of di-(2-ethylhexyl)phosphoric acid (HDEHP), a derivative of HDEHP, calixarenes, diglycoamide derivatives, carbamoylphosphine oxide derivatives, tributylphosphate (TBP), monoamide derivatives, and tertiary amines, and quaternary ammonium salts.

10. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein separating comprises filtering, precipitating, liquid-liquid extraction or chromatography, or wherein the method further comprises filtering, precipitating, liquid-liquid extraction, or chromatography.
11. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the organic phase comprises a non-selective extractant.
12. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the organic phase does not comprise an extractant that selectively binds to the one or more metal ions.
13. The method of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the metallic precursor comprises actinium.
14. The method of claim 13, wherein the actinium is separated from an M<4+> metal.
